lines.6: 「By the way, why did you tell me to come home early today?」
lines.7: 「Final exams are one month away. I thought we could devise your study plan together.」
lines.8: 「...I can figure that out on my own.」
lines.9: Honestly. She was such a meddlesome big-sister type.
lines.10: 「You have always been too easy on yourself. Without me here, you would most likely slack off again.」
lines.12: 「You used to say the same thing while denying it. I cannot trust you.」
lines.13: 「You keep saying 'back then' and 'you used to'... I told you, I don't remember that far back.」
lines.15: 「Forgetting your memories with me, your elder sister... How cold of you.」
lines.16: 「It's not like we have that many important memories together.」
lines.18: 「That remark has wounded me deeply. I looked after you so devotedly... even more than my own brother.」
lines.19: Well... 'looked after' might not be the right phrase...
lines.21: 「Very well. If a kick brought back your memories of me last time, perhaps it would be amusing to see what I must do to drag out the rest.」
lines.22: 「W-Wait, Otome! You don't have to get that angry!」
lines.23: 「I suppose you have forgotten the promise we made back then too.」
lines.25: 「Grr... It does not matter to me now. What infuriates me is that I remember and you forgot!」
lines.27: 「I shall beat that frivolous nature out of you!」
lines.29: 「Agh... She really put me through the wringer.」
lines.33: My muscles felt like lead. I collapsed without thinking.
lines.34: 「We're making ourselves at home over here.」
lines.35: 「Too much at home. Stop trolling message boards on my computer.」
lines.36: 「...Sigh. I'm too tired even to get angry.」
lines.37: 「So what? Building muscle is good for you. Heave-ho.」
lines.38: 「Hey, don't sit on me! I'm not a chair!」
lines.39: 「Why did she put you through such brutal training today, anyway?」
lines.42: 「Basically, she's angry that I forgot about her.」
lines.43: 「I wonder what that promise with Otome was.」
lines.44: 「Probably something like, 'If you get a good baseball card, give it to me.'」
lines.45: 「In dating sims, childhood promises always turn out to be something like, 'Marry me someday.'」
lines.48: 「If the payoff is really that trite, I'll go give the Princess and Yashi flying cross chops.」
lines.49: 「Besides, even I would remember it one hundred percent if I'd promised someone marriage.」
lines.50: 「So I can state with absolute certainty that isn't it!」
lines.51: 「Even when I think about it seriously, I can't see why she got so mad.」
lines.52: 「Well, Otome said it didn't matter to her now, so it can't have been that important.」
